description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion, adding {C}{C}
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodsoaked Champion enters, Davvol triggers, adding {B} and causing you to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
